module_summary: Four-stage pipelined 64-bit ripple-carry adder: 16-bit slices add per stage with carry registers, skewed operand and sum delay registers, and an enable shift chain producing o_en.

anchors.name: adda
anchors.why: 64-bit operand A, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: addb
anchors.why: 64-bit operand B, split into four 16-bit slices.

anchors.name: result
anchors.why: 65-bit sum concatenated from final carry and aligned slice sums.

anchors.name: i_en
anchors.why: Input valid; enables first slice add and enters the stage enable chain.

anchors.name: o_en
anchors.why: Output valid, delayed from stage3, marks result availability.

anchors.name: stage1
anchors.why: Pipeline valid chain bit enabling second slice addition; stage2/stage3 replicate it.

anchors.name: s1
anchors.why: First 16-bit slice sum register; s2-s4 are later stages.

anchors.name: s4
anchors.why: Top slice sum computed in final stage, feeds result.

anchors.name: c1
anchors.why: Registered carry propagated between slice stages; c2-c4 replicate.

anchors.name: a2_ff1
anchors.why: Operand skew register delaying upper slices to their stage.

anchors.name: s1_ff1
anchors.why: Sum alignment delay register so lower slices exit with s4.

groups.name: Valid shift chain
groups.description: Shifts i_en through stage1-3 to o_en, enabling each slice add.

groups.name: Slice adders
groups.description: Four 16-bit adders with registered carries chained across stages.

groups.name: Operand skew
groups.description: Slices operands and delays upper slices to match carry arrival.

groups.name: Sum alignment
groups.description: Delays lower slice sums so all slices form result together.
